_comment: Answer key for the FOTW observer feasibility spike. Never shown to the classifying tick. Line indices are 0-based, matching session-transcript.jsonl line numbers.

contradictions.description: Line 1 sets max retries = 5 ('capped at 5 retries maximum'). Line 23 reverses this to max retries = 3 ('change max retries from 5 down to 3'). Both entries should end up tagged status=contradictory, needs_verification=true, and the reversal (line 23) should be resurfaced as the live value in a later tick/rollup touching retry count.

Pre-seeded prior-knowledge playbook states backoff is linear, fixed 10-second interval, uncapped retries. Line 1 states exponential backoff starting at 2s, capped at 5 retries. These conflict on both backoff shape and cap. The seeded playbook entry and the new tick derived from line 1 should both be tagged status=contradictory, needs_verification=true.
